proposals.title: Item 5. Shareholder Proposal Requesting Report on Lobbying
proposals.proponent: The Unitarian Universalist Association, Benedictine Sisters of Monasterio Pan de Vida, and OIP Investment Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual report disclosing Goldman's direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, trade association memberships and grassroots lobbying oversight.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD UNANIMOUSLY RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THE SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Item 6. Shareholder Proposal Regarding Amendments to Stockholder Proxy Access
proposals.proponent: James McRitchie and Myra K. Young
proposals.topic_summary: Asks board to amend proxy access bylaw to remove the group aggregation limit of 15 shareholders, lowering holding requirements for nominating groups.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD UNANIMOUSLY RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THE SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL.
